model: EE800D room CO2, humidity and temperature transmitter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: E+E EE800 room transmitters with the RS485 BACnet MS/TP output.
summary: The EE800D is a room transmitter for CO2, relative humidity and temperature that works as a BACnet MS/TP smart sensor. Besides the measured values it calculates dew point, frost point, absolute humidity, mixing ratio, enthalpy and vapor pressure, each as its own Analog Input.
notes: Object list from the PICS sections 11-12 (v1.2, dated 19.5.2015).
The PICS says CO2raw is only for special applications that need a faster response.
Units are selectable per object; the object description changes with the unit.
All objects are read-only except Present_Value while Out_Of_Service is true.

integration.summary: Set a unique device instance and MAC address, then poll the Analog Inputs. Most jobs only need temperature, humidity and averaged CO2.
setup: Device instance (0-4194302) and device name are writable and kept in non-volatile memory; the default name is the model plus 8 unique characters.
RS485 settings are one writable string property, default "38400-8n1"; baud 9600-115200, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit fixed.
Max Master is writable, up to 127.
ReinitializeDevice and DeviceCommunicationControl need the password printed in the PICS.
gotchas: Present_Value is only writable while Out_Of_Service is true; the value then defaults to 50.0.
